description: Capability for the main window. `core:window:allow-start-dragging` is listed explicitly because `core:window:default` does NOT include it: with `titleBarStyle: Overlay` the native title area is gone, so `data-tauri-drag-region` is the only thing that moves the window, and it calls `startDragging()` — which the ACL denies silently, leaving a window that cannot be moved. The `-webkit-app-region` rules in src/index.css do not substitute for this; that is a Chromium mechanism and is inert under WKWebView.
